summary: Describes an Ansible playbook that creates a local user and maps a self-signed certificate for certificate auth, driven by username and cert_pem variables; CA-issued certs need the playbook edited to import the CA into LocalMachine\Root.
questions: Can I automate WinRM certificate mapping with an Ansible playbook?
What variables does the certificate mapping playbook need?

answer_card.title: Automating certificate mapping with Ansible
answer_card.answer_md: The guide provides a playbook that creates a local user and maps the certificate. Set `username` (user to create) and `cert_pem` (path to the public PEM). It assumes a **self-signed** cert; for a CA-issued cert, edit it to copy and import the CA into `LocalMachine\Root` instead.
